title: Request for a time-boxed Business Cloud evaluation without payment method
text: Hello Retool team, We have created a Free Retool Cloud workspace for a bounded, non-production technical evaluation: Workspace: https://nexoracore.retool.com/ We need to validate Business-tier capabilities required for our security and governance proof, specifically: Audit logs Rich permissions Resource environment permissions Could you please enable a time-boxed Retool Business Cloud evaluation for this workspace? We cannot add a payment method or accept automatic conversion to a paid subscription. Please confirm the evaluation expiry date and that the evaluation creates no automatic paid commitment. We will use the evaluation only for this bounded non-production validation. Thank you.
triage_reason: Business needs a time-boxed evaluation of enterprise software features.
